summary.name: Fireflies.ai
summary.one_liner: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, summarizes, and searches conversations from meetings, calls, and uploaded audio or video files.
use_cases: Searching past calls for a specific sentence or topic
Transcribing phone calls from dialers like Aircall or RingCentral
Turning MP3, MP4, WAV or M4A recordings into transcripts
Tracking speaking time and participation in meetings
Syncing meeting notes and tasks to CRM, project management, and Slack
summary.what_it_does: Fireflies has a bot (Fred) that can be invited to a live meeting or set to auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize them. It also offers a Chrome extension for Google Meet, a mobile app for in-person conversations, a desktop app, and dialer integrations plus an API for processing audio files. Transcripts support speaker recognition, 100+ languages, and automatic language detection, and are searchable down to the sentence and timestamp. AskFred lets users ask questions across their meetings, and a Live Assist feature offers real-time suggestions during calls. The page also mentions 200+ AI Skills, an MCP integration, and integrations with CRM, project management, ATS, and Slack.
notable: Searchable transcripts down to specific sentence and timestamp, with AskFred Q&A across meetings
Security claims: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 42001, HIPAA BAA and FERPA DSA on Enterprise, GDPR
Integrations with CRM, project management, ATS, Slack, and dialers like Aircall and RingCentral
Live Assist gives real-time suggestions and coaching during meetings
caveats: HIPAA BAA, FERPA DSA and Private Storage are available on Enterprise plan only
Pricing tiers are not stated on the page
